newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark's Superfos buys U.K. Thurgar Bolle.
newsitem.headline: Denmark's Superfos buys U.K. Thurgar Bolle.

text.p: Danish chemicals and packaging group Superfos said on Monday that it had signed a letter of intent to buy British packaging firm Thurgar Bolle Ltd, of Kettering, from the Heywood Williams Group.

A Superfos statement said that the two sides had agreed not to disclose the purchase price but it described Thurgar Bolle as having annual turnover of around 85 million Danish crowns and 110 employees.
Superfos recently failed in a bid to take over Danish roadbuilder Phoenix Contractors but has said it is looking at around 25 companies as potential acquisitions.
It said the Thurgar Bolle purchase was part of a strategy to increase its market share in Britain.

A spokesman said that Runcorn-based British unit Superfos Packaging Ltd was already one of the country's largest producers of injection-moulded plastic containers, which are also Thurgar Bolle's main product.
